sentences.en: Today, throughout the tense standoff between Russia and Ukraine, the United States has taken its most powerful tool for stopping an invasion off the table.
sentences.zh: 今天，在俄罗斯和乌克兰之间紧张的对峙中，美国已经放弃了其阻止入侵的最有力手段。

sentences.en: I asked my colleague, David Sanger, exactly why that is.
sentences.zh: 我问了我的同事大卫·桑格，这究竟是为什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月17日，星期四。

sentences.en: David, I want to begin by asking you to explain where the situation between Russia and Ukraine stands at this very moment and how great the risk of war between them
sentences.zh: 大卫，我想先请你解释一下俄乌局势目前的状况，以及考虑到过去48小时左右发生的事情，

sentences.en: is given what's happened over the past 48 hours or so.
sentences.zh: 它们之间爆发战争的风险有多大。

sentences.zh: 俄罗斯官员，但我们在实地并没有看到太多变化。

sentences.en: The Russians say that they have ordered back to barracks a good number of their troops who were engaged in these military exercises right on Ukraine's border.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯方面表示，他们已经命令大量在乌克兰边境进行军事演习的部队返回驻地。

sentences.en: But we've only actually seen that happen down near Crimea, which Russia annexed in 2014.
sentences.zh: 但实际上我们只看到这发生在克里米亚附近，俄罗斯在2014年吞并了那里。

sentences.en: And we have not seen it happen up in Belarus, where they've put their forces within striking distance of Kiev, the Ukrainian capital.
sentences.zh: 而在白俄罗斯，我们并没有看到这种情况，他们将部队部署在距离乌克兰首都基辅的打击范围内。

sentences.en: And we haven't seen it to the east, where the Russians have a long border with Ukraine and would presumably come in as one of the main victories of attack.
sentences.zh: 在东部我们也还没看到，那里俄罗斯与乌克兰有漫长的边界，据推测那里会是主要的进攻方向之一。

sentences.en: So right now, we're just trying to find out if this is rhetorical or real.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，我们只是想弄清楚这到底是口头说说还是动真格的。

sentences.en: And you've heard both
sentences.zh: 你已经听到了

sentences.en: President Biden and Secretary of State Antony Blinken say that so far, they really haven't seen any evidence of de-escalation.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统和国务卿安东尼·布林肯都表示，到目前为止，他们确实没有看到任何局势缓和的迹象。

sentences.en: So we think the possibility of an attack remains pretty high.
sentences.zh: 所以我们认为发生攻击的可能性仍然相当高。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.zh: 那么，考虑到这一点，大卫，我想转入我们今天谈话的核心问题。

sentences.en: And at the core of it is that there really is not a vital national interest to send Americans in to preserve Ukraine's sovereignty.
sentences.zh: 其核心在于，派遣美国人去维护乌克兰的主权确实不属于重大的国家利益。

sentences.zh: 为什么保护乌克兰不属于战略国家利益？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, when you think about national interests, you have to really think about the great Asians.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，当你思考国家利益时，你必须真正考虑那些重大的考量。

sentences.en: And the most vital national interest, of course, is protecting the United States from existential threats like a nuclear exchange, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，最核心的国家利益是保护美国免受核战争等生存威胁，对吧？

sentences.en: So it's fairly clear that you would do anything,
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，如果你认为美国将

sentences.zh: 在核战争中被摧毁，或者遭受破坏我们生活方式的毁灭性网络攻击，你会做任何事，

sentences.zh: 但只要想想美国实际上决定派遣军队进入外国险境的那些例子。

sentences.en: It is the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: They would not turn them over.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝交出这些人。

sentences.en: None of these demands were met.

sentences.en: And now the Taliban will pay a price.

sentences.en: That was an easy and clear case.
sentences.zh: 那是一个简单而明确的案例。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 现在，布什随后又做出了一个误解美国国家利益的典型案例，那就是他决定进入伊拉克。

sentences.en: On my orders, coalition forces have begun striking selected targets of military importance to undermine Saddam Hussein's ability to wage war.
sentences.zh: 根据我的命令，联军已经开始打击具有军事重要性的选定目标，以削弱萨达姆·侯赛因发动战争的能力。

sentences.en: There he almost fabricated on the basis of faulty and some would say politicized intelligence a threat to the United States.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他几乎是基于错误且有人说是政治化的情报，捏造了对美国的威胁。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: So, David, how does Ukraine fit into that history when we think about U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，大卫，当我们思考美国

sentences.en: national interest?
sentences.zh: 国家利益时，乌克兰如何符合那段历史？

sentences.en: I was struck by the fact that a couple of the elements that you just described would seem to apply to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我感到震惊的是，你刚才描述的几个要素似乎也适用于乌克兰。

sentences.en: For example, a Russian incursion into Ukraine would represent a country invading its neighbor like Iraq did to Kuwait
sentences.zh: 例如，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰将代表一个国家像伊拉克对科威特那样入侵其邻国，

sentences.en: and would undoubtedly create a humanitarian crisis within Ukraine along the lines of what we saw in Bosnia, no?
sentences.zh: 并且无疑会在乌克兰境内造成像我们在波斯尼亚看到的那样的人道主义危机，不是吗？

sentences.en: Michael, you're exactly right.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is that President Biden has concluded that we don't have a major national interest here.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，拜登总统已经得出结论，我们在这里没有重大的国家利益。

sentences.en: There's not much we get from Ukraine that we need the way we needed oil flowing out of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们从乌克兰那里得到的并不多，不像我们需要中东石油流动那样。

sentences.en: And that the humanitarian interest, while great, is not something that the American public is really willing to go pursue at this moment.
sentences.zh: 而且人道主义利益虽然巨大，但并不是美国公众目前真正愿意去追求的东西。

sentences.en: But if protecting Ukraine itself, David, isn't in our national interest, isn't keeping Russia in check and telling it,
sentences.zh: 但大卫，如果保护乌克兰本身不符合我们的国家利益，那么遏制俄罗斯并告诉它，

sentences.en: much as we told Iraq in the early 90s, you can't just invade another country, that's not okay, isn't that in our strategic national interest?
sentences.zh: 就像我们在90年代初告诉伊拉克那样，你不能随意入侵另一个国家，这是不对的，这难道不符合我们的战略国家利益吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实符合。

sentences.en: And the question is, where does it fit in?

sentences.en: It's not a vital national interest, but preserving the sanctity of nations' borders, stopping Russia from trying to reconstitute elements of the old Soviet Union,

sentences.en: that's definitely an important national intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个重要的国家利益。

sentences.en: And so that brings us to the second reason that sending in troops isn't on the table right now.

sentences.en: You know, you quickly figure out this is a pretty complicated question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你很快就会发现这是一个相当复杂的问题。

sentences.en: Because, frankly, Russia isn't just like any other adversary.
sentences.zh: 因为坦率地说，俄罗斯并不像其他任何对手。

sentences.en: It has more nuclear weapons than any other country on Earth.
sentences.zh: 它拥有的核武器比地球上任何其他国家都多。

sentences.en: In the past decade or so, it's demonstrated a willingness to be extremely disruptive with its cyber power, a fairly new capability.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年左右的时间里，它表现出愿意利用其网络力量进行极具破坏性的活动，这是一种相当新的能力。

sentences.en: And so all of these are enormous impediments that any president's got to think about because the Russians have a way of reaching back here to the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，所有这些都是任何总统都必须考虑的巨大障碍，因为俄罗斯有一种方式可以反击到美国本土。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In other words, Russia is not Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，俄罗斯不是阿富汗。

sentences.en: Russia is not Iraq.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯不是伊拉克。

sentences.en: Russia is a superpower.
